name: Gossiping Woman
message: "That woman's suspicious, I tell you. Where did she get all that money from? There's no way her husband's earning that much."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ah. Yeah... there she is."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "But I know what's really going on. That woman, she's doing *that* kind of work! It wouldn't make sense otherwise!"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Looks like she's still spewing BS left and right."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Oh yeah, now that my memories are back..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "That granny talked a lot of crap about me, too. She just wouldn't stop blabbing all over the place."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Stuff like my parents not getting along and stuff. You know, delicate... private stuff."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Oh, back when we were alive, I mean. She was already like that even then."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "No idea where she heard all that, but she knew way too much... and I wasn't the only one she screwed over."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "You get why I call her a hag or a gossip factory, yeah? She's bad news."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "She was still alive when I died, so her death was probably pretty recent."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Even as a ghost, she won't stop yapping. Pathetic, don'tcha think?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "She doesn't even realize that she's dead, or that no one's paying her any attention."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Heck, she probably doesn't even recognize me anymore, or anyone else at this point."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Or maybe she never really did know anything about me in the first place and just talked crap anyway... Oh well, whatever."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "She doesn't look like it, but that hag's probably barely holding it together. Eh, I'm sure she'll just go poof on her own."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Well, even so, she still remembers all the rumors she yaps about. Probably knows about the case too. Maybe."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Anyway, let's gooo! Charge~!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "You'd normally need a prettier face for that line of work. Something's fishy."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Excuse me~! Got a moment~?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "She's probably got another source of money, a sponsor or something. Either way, she's bad news."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hellooo~! Excuuuse meeeee~!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Oh, would you quiet down already?! Wait, you two. Why aren't you in school?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hah?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Wandering around a place like this since morning? Don't blame me if the police pick you up."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "It ain't even morning. She's definitely losing it."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Kids these days. Honestly, I have no idea what goes on in their heads. Just look at Aoi's girl. I swear she's up to something sleazy."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ugh, who cares about that? We just wanna..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "...ask you some..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Screw this, I give up."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "You handle this. I'll just watch. Go go~"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "You know I don't like Yasuda-san one bit why did he even get elected there's definitely something shady going on people who look nice on the surface are always hiding something."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Oh, right. Did you hear? Takeuchi's husband is cheating, I tell you, cheating. I saw it myself, him in a cafe with some woman. Not his wife, but a young girl. A really young one at that."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "This hag just can't stop yapping, can she? Same shit, every single day."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "But his mistress is just as bad. Does she even realize she's tearing his family apart? Of course she doesn't, that's why she keeps doing such foolish things."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "If we wait for her to stop, she'll probably never shut up. This is a waste of time. Let's cut to the chase."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Go on, you got this~"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "In the end, people just live miserable, unfulfilled lives. If you're happy like me, you wouldn't even think about cheating."
(Interrupt)
(Wait for her to finish)

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "You see it all the time with celebrities too. Cheating and affairs. I can tell, you know? Who's cheating on who. I'm always right, after all."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "See? Didn't I tell you? You've gotta be more assertive. Raise your voice or something. Now go get 'em!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "You see it all the time with celebrities too. Cheating and affairs. I can tell, you know. Like, ah, these two are definitely together. I'm always right, after all."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "C'mon, stop chickening out. Go go~. You've got this~"
(Interrupt)
(Wait for her to finish)

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "You know those girls who suddenly blow up overnight? They're sleeping their way to the top, no doubt about it, I can tell. Yup, that's right, my intuition's just that good."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Louder! Ah, screw it. Let's just slug her, yeah? That's basically fair game now."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "You see it all the time with celebrities too. Cheating and affairs. I can tell, you know. Like, ah, these two are definitely together. I'm always right, after all."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Heeey, what're you doiiing? Don't tell me you're actually into this kind of talk?"
(Interrupt)
(Wait patiently)

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "What is wrong with you?! Didn't anyone teach you to listen when someone's talking?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Oh yeah? Like anything that comes outta your mouth is ever worth a damn, dumbass."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Watch your mouth, young lady!"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ah."
(Try again)
(Return to Title Screen)

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "At this point, one look at someone's face tells me everything. I can't help it. I just end up knowing everyone's secrets. Is this what they call observation skills? I swear, being too sharp can be a problem sometimes."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "No, seriously. What the heck are you doing? You chickening out or something?"
(Tell her about the gossiping woman's trigger)

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Huh? Seriously? She freaks out if someone interrupts her?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ugh, what a pain. This hag's such a pain..."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Hey, could you stop all that muttering? ...What? You need something?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Holy crap. Now she's suddenly paying attention to us."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So, uh... there's something we wanna ask you, thought you might know about it."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "What? What do you want?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Okay, now she's normal all of a sudden... The heck is with those mood swings?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Well? Spit it out already."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So uh, about that incident, er... what was it called again?"
"Preschool Girl Serial Kidnapping and Murder Incident"
"Pretty Girl Serial Kidnapping and Murder Incident"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Right, that. The kidnappings."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Right, right, the serial kidnapping case. The one that caused a big stir."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Wow, she's actually following along... this is really throwing me off..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Right right... Wait, what?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "C'mon, buddy. Pull it together. Quit with the half-assed jokes, they're not landing."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "You mean the serial kidnapping case? The one that caused a big stir?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Okay, it landed. All's well that ends well."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "I actually know the truth behind that case, you see."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "What? You serious?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Someone ought to have taught you some manners, young lady."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Are you serious, ma'am?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Dead serious. I even did an interview, you see. I know who the culprit is!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "You know Yasuda-san, right? It was his son, I tell you."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "You mean that sleazebag who's always grinning at the park?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Right! You're completely right! What was his first name again... I forgot."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "He's always hanging around the park, ogling the kids, right? Not working or anything. Always just staring at children with that sleazy look on his face."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "I knew right from the start, I tell you! The moment they found the first body, I knew it was Yasuda-san's son!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Well, it was no surprise. Anyway, I even told a reporter, you know. That it was Yasuda-san's son. I think it was for some magazine? Or maybe a newspaper?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "But guess what? I know even more. There was another culprit."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Another culprit?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Think about it for a second. No matter how young those kids are, there's no way they'd go along with a guy that suspicious, right?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "He had an accomplice, I tell you! An accomplice!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "It was a girl! Right, that girl was working with him!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "What was her name again? Ta... Ta, what was it? Tani..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Kugayama Shiori?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Ah! That's right! Kugayama-san! Shiori-chan from the Kugayamas! You sure know a lot!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Looks like you know about it already, everyone did. It was famous. That Shiori-chan was the accomplice."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Tell us more, please~"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "What do you mean, more? You don't know? Everyone already does, you know."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Think about it for a second. No matter how young those kids are, there's no way they'd go along with a guy that suspicious, right?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "There was someone else doing the kidnapping. Shiori-chan was the one luring them away."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Shiori-chan's a student, remember? In middle school. Or was it high school? Plus she's a girl. Little kids would follow her without a second thought, you know."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Shiori-chan would talk to the kids and bring them over to Yasuda-san. That's what was really going on behind the scenes!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "I swear, Yasuda-san must've had some dirt on her."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "There were even eyewitnesses, you know. They all saw Shiori-chan walking around with a little girl. Over and over."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "And that's not all! Get this, people even saw Yasuda-san and Shiori-chan together!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "There's no doubt about it. They were accomplices. Shiori-chan did the kidnapping, and Yasuda-san did the killing."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "But you know, maybe Shiori-chan couldn't handle it anymore. That girl died, you see. I think... she killed herself? Right, suicide!"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "And you know what? This is the important part. After Shiori-chan died, the incidents stopped dead. Just like that."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "After Shiori-chan died, the police must've paid Yasuda-san a visit. Their connection was obvious, after all. I even gave testimony myself. Interviews too."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "And then—BAM! Kids stopped getting kidnapped, just like that."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "What else is that supposed to mean?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Those two were the culprits. Scary, isn't it? Setting Yasuda-san aside, who would've imagined that such a harmless-looking girl would do heinous crimes like that?"

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Well, it just goes to show you can't judge a book by its cover. She got what she deserved."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "Maybe her dying was her way of taking responsibility. But you know, that's pretty irresponsible too. She didn't even think about how her family would feel. She only thought about herself."

name: Gossiping Woman
message: "She was still in what, middle school? High school? Anyway, she was just a kid, so I guess it was only natural she'd be that shallow. But if she'd taken life more seriously, she wouldn't have been threatened like that. Truly foolish."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "'Kay, thanks for the info..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message:
"......
You okay?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Well, can't blame you for making that face."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "But hey, that hag loves to exaggerate. Like, 90\% of that was probably BS. I mean..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yeah... but still... Yasuda, right? What she said pretty much lines up with that old dude's story..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "That said, that hag did say Shiorin was getting threatened and all."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So maybe she didn't have a choice. Like, her life would've been over, so she had no option but to do what that old guy said, y'know?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yeah... I shouldn't be so quick to call her an accomplice..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Let's just ask directly."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "No, I mean the old guy, not Shiorin. We don't even know where Shiorin is, and she probably doesn't remember anything, anyway."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "As for that old guy, well, he's basically the culprit at this point. Let's just ask him directly. Like, what really happened."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "And then we can clear up what was really going on with Shiorin."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Now, where'd that old guy run off to... hmm..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hey, maybe the convenience sto... Ah, no, the park, I mean. The place you always meet up with Shiorin. The one near the convenience store."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Try hanging around that park. Shiorin might wander back there."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I'll go look for the old dude. I'll call you if I find him."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So just sit tight and wait there, okay?"
"Okay."
"Nah."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Aye aye. Okay, I'm off. Later~!"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hold it right there, buddy. Wandering around together won't get us anywhere."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "You stay at the park, alright? I'll call you if I find him."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Okay, I'm off. Later~"
I should head to the park.
